subject: reasoning
question: Rosie starts from point A and drives 7 km towards the west. Then she turns left, drives 5 km, turns left again, drives 12 km, then turns right and drives 9 km. She turns right for the last time, drives 5 km and stops at point P. How far (minimum distance) does she have to travel to reach point A again and in which direction should she drive? (All turns are assumed to be 90° unless otherwise specified)
solution:
​According to given information, [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c0bf11c23bbf01226f87d7facc2100da4dea7ae3de07209c0ef7633fc17c80d.png] 

She has to travel 9 km + 5 km = 14 km North to reach again Point A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
